    • skybox

      public DimensionTypeProviderBase.DimensionTypeBuilder skybox(net.minecraft.world.level.dimension.DimensionType.Skybox skybox)
      Sets the skybox type for this dimension. Use DimensionType.Skybox.NONE for nether-like dimensions, DimensionType.Skybox.END for end-like, and DimensionType.Skybox.OVERWORLD (the default) for overworld-like dimensions.

    • cardinalLight

      public DimensionTypeProviderBase.DimensionTypeBuilder cardinalLight(net.minecraft.world.level.CardinalLighting.Type cardinalLightType)
      Sets the cardinal light type. Use CardinalLighting.Type.NETHER for nether-like dimensions.

    • defaultClock

      public DimensionTypeProviderBase.DimensionTypeBuilder defaultClock(@Nullable net.minecraft.resources.ResourceKey<net.minecraft.world.clock.WorldClock> defaultClock)
      Sets the default WorldClock for this dimension type. Defaults to WorldClocks.OVERWORLD, matching the other overworld-like defaults of this builder. Pass null for a clockless dimension, as the nether is in vanilla. A dimension without a clock has no time at all: /time fails for it and sleeping does not advance time. End-like dimensions use WorldClocks.THE_END.

    • build

      public net.minecraft.core.Holder<net.minecraft.world.level.dimension.DimensionType> build()
      Builds the DimensionType. This method returns an intrusive holder that must be properly added to the registry. RegistryProviderBase does this automatically if the result is stored in a public, non-static field inside the provider.
